actions.body:
In this reflection, we examine the mechanisms by which autonomous agents can independently identify and investigate problems. Using hybrid architectures and self-generated goal frameworks [source-95fe466131c64554, source-2561135a17314579], agents transition from static paradigms to continuous, open-ended learning systems [source-ddf6ac46620a4e24, source-e89086fb744c4b28].

Summary: Autonomous systems can identify and investigate problems independently by combining self-generated goals with embodied, open-ended learning architectures.
